segments.sn38.2:1.3: “Yo kho, āvuso, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo – idaṃ vuccati arahattan”ti.
segments.sn38.2:1.5: “Atthi panāvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa arahattassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti?
segments.sn38.2:1.6: “Atthi kho, āvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa arahattassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
segments.sn38.2:1.7: “Katamo panāvuso, maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa arahattassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti?
segments.sn38.2:1.8: “Ayameva kho, āvuso, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa arahattassa sacchikiriyāya, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn38.2:1.10: Ayaṃ kho āvuso, maggo, ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa arahattassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
segments.sn38.2:1.11: “Bhaddako, āvuso, maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa arahattassa sacchikiriyāya.

lines: Arahattapañhabyākaraṇe yasmā arahattaṃ rāgadosamohānaṃ khīṇante uppajjati, tasmā “rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo”ti vuttaṃ.
Yo pana imināva suttena kilesakkhayamattaṃ nibbānanti vadeyya, so vattabbo “kassa kilesānaṃ khayo, kiṃ attano, udāhu paresan”ti?
Kiṃ pana gotrabhuñāṇakkhaṇe kilesā khīṇā khīyanti khīyissantīti?
“Khīṇā”ti vā “khīyantī”ti vā na vattabbā,“khīyissantī”ti pana vattabbāti.
Kiṃ pana tesu akhīṇesuyeva kilesesu gotrabhuñāṇaṃ kilesakkhayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ karotīti?
Maggakkhaṇepi hi kilesā “khīṇā”ti vā “khīyissantī”ti vā na vattabbā,“khīyantī”ti pana vattabbā, na ca akhīṇesuyeva kilesesu kilesakkhayo ārammaṇaṃ hoti, tasmā sampaṭicchitabbametaṃ.
Yaṃ āgamma rāgādayo khīyanti, taṃ nibbānaṃ.
Taṃ panetaṃ “rūpino dhammā arūpino dhammā”tiādīsu (dha. sa. dukamātikā 11) dukesu arūpino dhammāti saṅgahitattā na kilesakkhayamattamevāti.
